title: MINITAUR -- Moog Minitaur-style monophonic bass synth

sections.heading: USING IT
lines: Turn audio on (Options > Audio Status), then play MIDI or the KEYBOARD. Notes above C5 are clamped.
OSC: FINE TUNE, VCO2 FREQ (+/-12 semitones), VCO1/VCO2 SQ (on = square, off = saw).
H.SYNC locks VCO2 to VCO1; N.SYNC restarts both oscillators on each note.
MIX: VCO1 LVL, VCO2 LVL and EXT LVL (audio input 1); high levels saturate gently.
FILTER: CUTOFF, RESONANCE (self-oscillates near max), EG AMT (bipolar), KB TRK, FLT VEL.
FILT EG and AMP EG: attack, decay and sustain; RELEASE on = release uses the decay time.
AMP VEL sets velocity to loudness; LEGATO stops envelopes restarting on tied notes.
LFO: RATE, LFO>VCO and LFO>VCF depths, WAVE (tri, square, saw, ramp, S&H, filter EG).
KEY TR restarts the LFO on each note; VCO2 O sends pitch LFO to VCO2 only.
PERF: GLIDE on/off, GLIDE RT, GLD TYP (constant rate, constant time, exponential), MOD WH.
VOLUME sets the output level. Number boxes beside each dial show its value.
The MIDI, OSC, MIX, GLIDE, ENV, LFO, FILT and VCA buttons open each section's subpatcher.

sections.heading: INPUTS & OUTPUTS
lines: MIDI notes, velocity, pitch bend, mod wheel and a Minitaur-style CC map (see p midi-input).
Audio in: adc~ 1 feeds EXT LVL. Audio out: the same mono voice on dac~ 1 and 2.

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: Two saw/square oscillators and the external input are mixed and soft-clipped with tanh~.
A gen~ Huovilainen ladder filter (24 dB/oct lowpass) shapes the tone.
gen~ envelopes, LFO and glide run at audio rate; sections talk over send/receive (mt-*).
